def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Solver, Or, Not, And

    # Base script variable
    dev = Int('dev')

    # Variables from constraint set 2 (all Int per guidelines)
    dev_flags = Int('dev_flags')
    cfg_fc_flags = Int('cfg_fc_flags')
    cfg_fc_ifindex = Int('cfg_fc_ifindex')
    cfg_fc_ignore_dev_down = Int('cfg_fc_ignore_dev_down')
    idev = Int('idev')
    idev_cnf_disable_ipv6 = Int('idev_cnf_disable_ipv6')
    net_loopback_dev = Int('net_loopback_dev')
    fib6_is_reject = Int('fib6_is_reject')
    addr_type = Int('addr_type')

    # Constants
    RTNH_F_ONLINK = 1
    IFF_UP = 1

    s = Solver()

    # Base script constraint
    s.add(dev == 0)

    # Constraint 1: !(cfg->fc_flags & RTNH_F_ONLINK) || (dev != NULL)
    s.add(Or((cfg_fc_flags & RTNH_F_ONLINK) == 0, dev != 0))

    # Constraint 2: (cfg->fc_ifindex == 0) || (dev != NULL)
    s.add(Or(cfg_fc_ifindex == 0, dev != 0))

    # Constraint 3: !fib6_is_reject || (dev == net->loopback_dev) || (idev != NULL)
    s.add(Or(fib6_is_reject == 0, dev == net_loopback_dev, idev != 0))

    # Constraint 4: !(cfg->fc_flags & RTNH_F_ONLINK) || ((dev->flags & IFF_UP) != 0)
    s.add(Or((cfg_fc_flags & RTNH_F_ONLINK) == 0, (dev_flags & IFF_UP) != 0))

    # Constraint 6: ((dev->flags & IFF_UP) != 0) || cfg->fc_ignore_dev_down
    s.add(Or((dev_flags & IFF_UP) != 0, cfg_fc_ignore_dev_down == 1))

    # Constraint 7: dev != NULL
    s.add(dev != 0)

    return s.check() == __import__('z3').sat
